objective: Validate AWG request and decision-record contracts deterministically without network, provider, agent, or transcript access.
assumptions: The repository schemas are the authoritative contract definitions
A dependency-free checker is sufficient for the schema vocabulary used by AWG
unknowns: Future schema keywords may require extending the checker before adoption
invariants: No network or provider process is started
A positive fixture passes only when all required nested contracts pass
A negative fixture is accepted by the test suite only when validation fails
acceptance_predicates: The checker resolves only local schema references
The checker emits deterministic pass/fail output
The contracts workflow runs the checker and negative test

formalization.scope: bounded request/record validation and fixture expectations
